countingRule: Included entries must correspond one-to-one to the assessment dataset. Queued leads, deferred or excluded candidates do not count. Counts describe this source snapshot; deployment must be verified separately.
evidencePolicy: Primary-source mechanism review and preliminary editorial scoring only. Unverified identity, repository licenses and checklist adoption cannot be inferred from a candidate name.
